objective: Test whether the median-runtime versus mean-success exponent gap persists as n -> infinity.

core_observables.tilted_variance_integral: n ln(2) integral_0^1 (1-lambda) Var_lambda(X_n) d lambda

A_stable_positive_gap.description: Later n-windows have positive window_gap with uncertainty excluding zero and no trend toward zero.

B_stable_positive_jensen.description: Jensen slope remains positive and explains most of the total gap.

C_stable_tilted_integral.description: The exact tilted-variance integral remains positive and does not decrease toward zero in late windows.

recommended_threshold.late_window_trend: statistically consistent with zero or positive

D_scaled_cumulants_monitored.description: Track n kappa2, n^2 kappa3, n^3 kappa4 instead of assuming Gaussian truncation.

E_tail_robustness.description: Mean success estimates should not be dominated by a tiny number of easiest observed instances.

F_multiseed_replication.description: Repeat across independent training and evaluation seeds.

recommended_run_stages.name: feasible_extension
recommended_run_stages.purpose: Check whether n=21..24 continues or breaks the current trend.

recommended_run_stages.name: late_window_confirmation
recommended_run_stages.purpose: Form later windows with less overlap with n=12..20.

recommended_run_stages.name: multi_seed_robustness
recommended_run_stages.purpose: Separate intrinsic behavior from angle/training/evaluation seed effects.

recommended_run_stages.name: tail_aware_check
actions: use tail-aware or importance-sampled estimates of E[p_succ]

satisfied: gap mostly explained by Jensen piece
exact tilted-variance integral explains Jensen piece
lambda=0 variance has right scale but overpredicts
top-tail mass and leave-one-out checks are not catastrophic
not_satisfied: evidence that tilted-variance integral stabilizes at large n
current_status.conclusion: Current result identifies the finite-window mechanism but does not establish asymptotic persistence.
